sections: Everybody Wins When You Partner with TaaS
More Affordable Than Contingency. Better Results.
textBlocks: Your agency gets guaranteed candidates. Your clients get faster fills. We get a sustainable partnership.
Performance-based agencies: deliver better results at lower cost than contingency recruiting.
Unlike contingency recruiting where someone loses, our model creates value for all parties.
Guaranteed candidate flow for every role
Handle 3x more client requests without hiring
Win competitive bids with faster delivery
Zero risk, pay only for candidates you use
Consistent delivery regardless of role type
Access to passive talent they can't reach
Expanded market reach through your network
Traditional contingency fees eat into your margins. Our subscription model gives you predictable costs and better outcomes.
Flexible options for agencies of all sizes. Start small and scale as you grow.
Never. This is 100% white-label. All candidate communications, branding, and interactions go through your firm. We're completely invisible to your clients.
You can start receiving candidates within 48 hours of signing up. We'll do a quick calibration call to understand your client needs, then begin sourcing immediately.
Our Starter tier is perfect for agencies that want overflow support. You can also pause and resume your subscription as needed. No long-term contracts required.
Yes. We have sourcing expertise across 22+ industries. If you get a request outside your specialization, we can likely fill it.
All candidates are pre-screened with verified experience, skills assessment, and availability confirmation. Our clients report 85%+ shortlist-to-interview conversion rates.
Join 50+ staffing agencies that deliver better results to their clients while growing their revenue with TaasFlow.
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.

h1: A partnership model built for agencies who value transparency.

headings.text: A partnership model built for agencies who value transparency.
A model where every side wins

sections: A partnership model built for agencies who value transparency.
A model where every side wins
textBlocks: TaaSFlow partners with staffing and recruiting agencies who want to extend their delivery capacity, cover more role types, and keep their clients close — using the same workspace, sourcing and evidence-based scoring we run for direct clients.
This programme complements the core TaaSFlow product; it does not replace it. Every partnership runs on the same operating system, the same intake, and the same evidence-first standards.
Extend delivery capacity without hiring recruiters
Take on roles outside your usual specialisation
Use one workspace to keep the whole search auditable
Keep your client relationship — we operate behind you
A structured workspace for reviews and decisions
Consistent quality across every role type
One accountable process from brief to hire
Roles that match our operating system
Continuous feedback that improves our sourcing
Each partnership is scoped to the role types, geographies, and volume you handle. We agree service standards up front and review them together.
Roles flow through our standard intake. Your team and ours share a workspace per client so there is one source of truth.
Commercials are agreed per partnership. We do not publish rate cards for partnerships — every arrangement is quoted on scope and volume.
You stay the primary relationship with your client. TaaSFlow operates as your delivery engine, with the level of visibility your client wants.
Send us a note about your agency and the roles you want to cover. We reply personally.
